incidents.name: ShadowFi SDF public burn
incidents.notes: SDF.burn(address,uint256) had no access control, so the attacker burned almost the entire SDF balance of the SDF/WBNB pair, synced it and swapped a small SDF holding for the pair's WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: SDF 0x10bc28d2810dD462E16facfF18f78783e859351b created 2022-08-26T06:20:16Z by 0x5671e238bee4cd57a5722038f846f35d8ca35ed7, unrelated to attack sender 0x4daa3135b016ac37c46ed03423d314caea89ff5e; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 1,078.62 WBNB left the SDF/WBNB pair to the attacker; 1,078.6167 WBNB x $276.60 at incidentTimestamp 1662087762 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $298,347.
